prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ENV01 midground, a SINGLE separately painted transparent game scenery layer on a full LANDSCAPE 1536 by 1024 canvas. Original mobile storybook puzzle game Almost God.
Primary request: Paint two delightful small harbor architecture clusters framing the upper left and upper right edges. Warm apricot plaster, terracotta tiled roofs, uneven arched windows, tiny lavender bougainvillea over an awning, a short open arcade. Simplified chunky handmade coastal village, polished gouache brush texture, creamy sunlit highlights, lavender shaded walls, sage greenery. Friendly and witty, not photorealistic.
Composition: Entire central 60 percent of canvas is fully transparent from top to bottom, and the entire lower 65 percent is fully transparent. Architecture is ONLY at the upper outer left and right corners, extending inward at most 20 percent from either side and downward at most 35 percent. The two groups stand near a high horizon and leave a huge clean empty action space. No connecting floor or background. Their bottom edges end as clean architectural silhouettes so a separate plaza floor will meet them.
Constraints: This is a compositing layer, NOT a complete picture. Genuine transparent alpha everywhere except painted architecture and tiny foliage attached to it. Full canvas remains 1536 by 1024 with transparent margins; do not tightly crop the two clusters. No sky, no water, no ground plane, no pale colored rectangle behind the art. No characters, no near props, no boats, no rope, no bollards, no text, no UI, no watermark.
